tickets.title: Global certificate API and contribution package
tickets.first_deliverable: AKS.Bounds.Certificate and upper-bound/contributions with a compiled smoke test
tickets.notes: Hardened 2026-10-12 (UB-16): pinned statement, definition fingerprint, eventual-bound spec.

tickets.title: Abstract the local column-sorter interface and identify the exact reusable laws
tickets.first_deliverable: Lean interface plus a cost table for replacing bitonic without touching separator mathematics

tickets.title: Search for a shallower full sorter at ordinary-node widths
tickets.first_deliverable: Candidate family with a proved depth below 800 at m around 2^42-2^43, or a documented obstruction
tickets.notes: S < 800 per sort would give coefficient < 1200 without changing the scheduler.

tickets.title: Reduce the ordinary-node height using stronger/tighter separator estimates
tickets.first_deliverable: Certified parameter window and end-to-end coefficient; two-round Variant B currently projects 1354.5 only
tickets.notes: Variant B (two tails, m >= 2^41) is a certified hand proof, not Lean-formalized; fringe route certifies down to f=92160 (F2ROUND.md).

tickets.title: Replace full column sorts with partial sorting / halving primitives
tickets.first_deliverable: State the weaker invariant sufficient for the next separator round and derive a depth budget
tickets.notes: UB-14 is the concrete first instance (approximate last sort).

tickets.title: Jointly optimize branching factor, number of rounds, and node geometry
tickets.first_deliverable: Small exact/rational parameter sweep with a valid global-schedule cost formula
tickets.notes: Parameter freedom of the current family is already exhausted: optimum near (x,y,z)=(5.8,9.9,4.5) (tapered/NOTES.md).

tickets.title: Improve expander/halver primitives and compose them with the current node contract
tickets.first_deliverable: A concrete halver depth/error pair and a compatible fringe/bulk guarantee
tickets.notes: Expander halvers cost ~1/eps depth; sort-based separators win for eps < 2^-4 (ruled-out.md).

tickets.title: Tapered stranger invariant allowing larger local error
tickets.first_deliverable: Recalibrated parameter model against the 1419 endpoint, then a target below 1200
tickets.notes: Explored 2026-10-11: the invariant is already tapered; a larger eps alone does not help; the lever is the schedule slack (UB-12). All-four-changes variant L4 ~780 windowed (model).

tickets.title: Compile the 2024 shallow high-arity k-sorters into binary sorters
tickets.first_deliverable: An explicit finite arity schedule and a proved binary coefficient below 200, or a quantitative barrier

tickets.title: Extract finite-M constants from Chvatal's M-sorter construction
tickets.first_deliverable: Prove a finite c_M at M=16 or 32 and check c_M * d2(M)/log2 M < 200

tickets.title: Recover the reported private sub-100 AKS construction
tickets.first_deliverable: Locate a public finite-parameter construction or identify the missing theorem/contract
tickets.notes: Chvatal DCS-TR-294 s.9, Seiferas s.7: Komlos 'around 60 to 100'; all sources unverified, no parameters given.

tickets.title: Price cumulative boundary displacement in the profile scheduler
tickets.first_deliverable: Prove the aggregate rank-window mismatch bound and recompute the rank-1 transfer coefficient

tickets.title: Slack-free non-uniform flow table (design D2, same invariant P)
tickets.first_deliverable: Stage 1b-2: per-child windows, deficit-form Lemma 4.1, generic RealSpecs over FlowFacts; then Stage 2 (D2 at (6,12,6)) and Stage 3 ((6,10,6) headline)
tickets.notes: Stage 0 gate GO (Python, exact); Lean Stage 1a and 1b-1 done on branch runaware (commit 177169a, package experiments/slackfree-lean, headline unchanged 1419). Estimated 5-8k Lean lines; no slope gain before Stage 3. Paused 2026-10-11 in favour of another route (~945).

tickets.title: Run-aware first column sort (skip merge levels using sorted input runs)
tickets.first_deliverable: Chunk invariant and inter-stage permutation Pi_t, then switch big nodes to physicalPackNetBlock
tickets.notes: Components proved in Lean (kernel-checked, experiments/runaware): block-merge column sorter (physicalPackNetBlock_exec/_depth_le), 2^29 divisibility of runs (NodeGeomD), GenNetwork stage composition (stages_sort). Payoff -12% at m~2^58 but only ~3% at the two-round window m~2^42.

tickets.title: Cheap approximate last sort (d-sorter for the third column sort)
tickets.first_deliverable: Note proving or refuting the promise: state the d-sorter, show output excess <= input excess + promise-tail mass (standard comparators never increase marks above a cut, cf. ScrambleMonotone), bound the tail with the BULK2 machinery; scale the displacement simulation with an adversary choosing input after sigma
tickets.notes: Idea from the 2026-10-12 discussion. Simulation (m=4096,n=256): sort-3 input displacement ~3*m^(1/4) rms (max ~115 adversarial) vs full height at sort 2. At m~2^42 a d-sorter with d~2^15-2^16 costs ~200 layers vs 903-946. Caveat: per-column tails vs L1 control against an adversary that picks the input after sigma. Stage depth 2838 -> ~2100 (coefficient ~1050).

tickets.title: Reduce the fringe floor (f below 2^17) for the two-round node
tickets.first_deliverable: Two-round fringe contract at f ~ 2^11-2^15, or a precise obstruction
tickets.notes: Route certifies f >= 92160 (F2ROUND.md); the fringe floor pins m >= ~2^40-2^42 since f ~ m*nu/(2Ak). Needed to drop m toward 2^34 (coefficient < 700 only with this plus UB-12 and UB-14).
